## 4. Shortcuts

| Action | Keys | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Command Palette | `Ctrl+Shift+P` | all commands start with Confluence |
| Markdown preview | `Ctrl+Shift+V` | the Pull and Publish buttons live here |
